records.text: Charlie Kirk flew into Salt Lake City instead of the closer Provo airport to do an interview with Andrew K. Smith

appearances.snippet: It is also how I felt—and I'm sharing this with you now for a reason—when I learned that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) flew into Salt Lake City that morning. Because why didn't he fly into the much closer Provo airport?
